sources.title: Mitigating Fabrication in Multi-Stage LLM Pipelines for Hiring:
sources.snippet: A reference AI (separate model family from the generation model) was permitted only for dictionary/search-style lookups of individual terms; delegating evaluation of pipeline output to any AI was prohibited, preserving the definition of C3 as a human checkpoint. Review sessions were capped at approximately 2-2.5 hours to control for fatigue.
